        int T = 1;
        while (T-- > 0) {
            String s = input.next();
            if (s.length() == 1) {
                char c = s.charAt(0);
                if (c == '0' || c == '_' || c == 'X') {
                    out.println(1);
                } else {
                    out.println(0);
                }
            } else {
                boolean hasX = false;
                for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
                    if (s.charAt(i) == 'X') {
                        hasX = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!hasX) {
                    out.println(computeValue(s));
                } else {
                    int total = 0;
                    for (int digit = 0; digit < 10; digit++) {
                        char[] chars = s.toCharArray();
                        for (int j = 0; j < chars.length; j++) {
                            if (chars[j] == 'X') {
                                chars[j] = (char) ('0' + digit);
                            }
                        }
                        total += computeValue(new String(chars));
                    }
                    out.println(total);
                }
            }
        }
        out.close();
    }

    public static int computeValue(String s) {
        int n = s.length();
        int ways = 0;
        if (s.charAt(0) != '0') {
            ways = 1;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 2; i++) {
            if (s.charAt(i) == '_') {
                if (i == 0) {
                    ways *= 9;
                } else {
                    ways *= 10;
                }
            }
        }
        int divisibleBy25Ways = 0;
        char last = s.charAt(n - 1);
        char secondLast = s.charAt(n - 2);
        if (last == '_' && secondLast == '_') {
            divisibleBy25Ways = 4;
        } else if (last == '_') {
            if (secondLast == '0' || secondLast == '5' || secondLast == '2' || secondLast == '7') {
                divisibleBy25Ways = 1;
            }
        } else if (secondLast == '_') {
            if (last == '0' || last == '5') {
                divisibleBy25Ways = 2;
            }
        } else {
            int lastTwo = Integer.parseInt(s.substring(n - 2));
            if (lastTwo % 25 == 0) {
                divisibleBy25Ways = 1;
            }
        }
        return ways * divisibleBy25Ways;
    }

        StringTokenizer st;
